description.ja: • 形状、ディテールを優先したパーツ分割で造型。
description.en: • Molded by dividing into parts with priority on shape and detail.

description.en: • The main body, which is based on red, is expressed in molded color, and the markings in various places are beautifully reproduced with the included water transfer decals.
